duplication_audit.withdrawn_axis: within-case MMD was withdrawn before sealing because P3 target-shift diagnostics and P1 v12 already used MMD
duplication_audit.novel_axis: fixed robust whole-distribution L-location, L-scale, L-skewness and L-kurtosis for levels and increments
duplication_audit.distinction: v42 estimates state-bin conditional increment moments, v43 uses increment characteristic functions, v60 uses extreme-order tail spacings, and v39 uses template entropy. v65 uses unconditional linear combinations of all order statistics through unbiased probability-weighted moments.
duplication_audit.official_v42_exclusion: the aggregate official v42 sign reversal is transport-risk context only and is excluded from features, gates, model fitting and candidate selection

encoder.input: historical hs, tp, hmax and wind-speed paths at fixed 20-minute subsampling from the past-only 48h context
path_types: one-step increment of robustly normalized level
encoder.probability_weighted_moments: unbiased b_r = n^-1 sum_{k=r+1}^n C(k-1,r)/C(n-1,r) x_(k:n), r=0..3

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Hosking, L-Moments: Analysis and Estimation of Distributions Using Linear Combinations of Order Statistics, JRSS B 52(1), 105-124 (1990)
primary_sources.use: robust distribution-shape motivation only; not performance evidence
